title: His mother's advice to amount to something
summary: His mother told him to amount to something, not to be ordinary.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: A few minutes ago we were mentioning his mother and the advice that she gave him that stuck with him his entire life was this: If you're going to try to play the piano, at least try to amount to something. And he said she emphasized the "something."

Then he went on to say, "It reminds me of a joke we used to tell, 'come on, fellows, let's get drunk and be somebody.'" But that was what it was all about, becoming somebody from deep inside. That was my feeling and I got it from her. Don't be just ordinary, be a little bit better.
